desc: Count character frequencies into an array `cnt` of size 26 and set `n = len(s)`.
Derive per-k cost model: only 1-step increments matter (longer moves = delete+insert, cost 2); savings formulation cost = n + Σ_active [k - 2·kept_i - in_i].
Design O(26) per-k DP with 2 states (prev letter active/inactive), avail_prev = max(0,c[i-1]-k) if active else c[i-1]; kept = min(c[i],k); in = min(avail_prev, k-kept).
Implement `makeStringGood`: loop k=1..n, run the 2-state DP over 26 letters, track min answer (delete-all cost n is covered by all-inactive path).
Verify against examples ("acab"→1, "wddw"→0, "aaabc"→2) and edge cases (single distinct letter, strings with 'z', k=n).
